x: …Radford flashing to a bronze medal in the 100 metres; Elliott toying with the world's best over 1500 metres; "wild-man" Cerutty running on to the track; Avril Williams throwing the javelin beyond the Olympic record and into second place, only in her excitement, to step over the line and be disqualif…
Those men who, through the passage of time, have been proved right were ridiculed in their day (Newton, Cerutty etc.) but those who have been proved wrong invariably get away with it.
Stars and scrubbers alike rub shoulders at this well known training base and it will surely not be long before the Cottage becomes more famous than Cerutty's camp at Portsea in Australia.

Such training may seem slightly dated now after Cerutty, Lydiard and the like have shown other ways to train. Nevertheless, Stampfl's methods had produced 4 minute milers and there are still few athletes who would not be happy to attain such a standard.
